verdict.rationale: The evidence shows open-source host-side software: the desktop and mobile companion apps and the libfido2-based fido2-manage CLI/GUI. Nothing in the pack says the key firmware itself is open source or has been independently audited. Open-source management tools are an adjacent feature and do not let you verify what runs on the device.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the firmware is open source or independently audited, so I don't have to take the vendor's word for what runs on the device
